title: Three-line headline that springs in on a tilt and swings out
summary: A stacked three-line headline grows in line by line from a small, slightly rotated state, overshoots and snaps level, holds, then swells and swings clockwise before collapsing back. A short punchy loop for one bold message.
use_when: A single bold three-beat message for an editorial or promo post
A silent looping social tile in 4:5 with a header mark and a CTA pill
The hook of a longer film where one headline must hit in under 1 s
Brands with a loud display grotesk and a two-colour palette

look.type_style: heavy grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking and leading (lines nearly touch), each line one word with a period, cap height ~6 % H, block ~80 % W; small bold wordmark top centre; outlined pill CTA bottom

sfx.event: headline lines snap level after the entrance overshoot
each line pops in from small, 1 fr apart

structure.shot: flat olive card: small wordmark top centre, outlined CTA pill at the bottom, a three-line one-word-per-line headline centred
structure.camera: static frame; only the headline block scales and rotates (header and pill never move)
structure.motion: f0-3 empty; lines enter f4/f5/f6 (stagger 1 fr, top first) from ~0.3 scale with their own tilt of a few degrees, springs.snappy, overshoot ~10-13 % at f8-10, level and settled by f20; hold f20-43 static; f44-53 block swells ~1.0 -> 1.3 and rotates ~8 deg clockwise on easings.inOutSine, peak f53-56; f57-62 eases back to ~1.15; f63-66 collapses to 0, bottom line first, stagger 1 fr, easings.inExpo; f67-71 empty

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the card, accent or fg for the headline, display font in a heavy weight
params.content.lines: exactly 3 headline lines, one short word each, ending in a period
params.content.cta: short uppercase label inside the outlined pill at the bottom
params.content.wordmark: small top-centre name; defaults to the brand wordmark
params.timing.hold: frames the level headline holds before the swing (default 24)
params.timing.stagger: frames between lines on entrance and exit (default 1)
params.swing.rotate: peak clockwise rotation of the block in degrees (default 8)
params.swing.scale: peak scale of the block during the swing (default 1.3)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from a 30 fps strip of all 72 frames (200 px wide): entrance starts f4, 1 fr line stagger, overshoot ~10-13 % (rough at this size), settled f20; hold 24 fr; swing peak f53-56 ~8 deg clockwise, ~1.3 scale; collapse f63-66 bottom line first; 5 empty frames at the end so the loop restarts on empty frames. The source motion is 2D rotation of each line, not a 3D plane: the catalogue hint 'tilt-plane' does not apply, and no glow is visible. Proposed term 'line-tilt-snap' (per-line rotated spring entrance) is not in the vocabulary, so techniques[] keeps statement-sequence (one statement beat) and hard-cut (loop point). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Header and CTA pill are static in every frame.
